responsibility: Enumerates the RVV intrinsic function groups in declarative form. Each `DEF_RVV_FUNCTION` entry ties a builtin base name to a semantic base class, naming/typing shape, supported predication forms, and operand/type family, supplying the master intrinsic inventory that riscv-vector-builtins.cc expands into concrete overloaded and non-overloaded builtin declarations.
